title: The Curse of the Goddess
subtitle: A Mysterious Invitation, A Deadly Legend
summary: Feluda, Lalmohan Babu, and Topshe set out for a tranquil winter holiday in Hazaribagh, only to find themselves drawn into a web of intrigue connected to a legendary curse. As secrets unravel and danger looms, the trio must use all their wits to separate myth from reality. Will a simple vacation transform into their most confounding case yet?
